Hi Samira / Alex —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so everyone has the same view: 

- Primary use case: real-time anomaly detection in transaction streams (low-latency embedding lookups + light reranking).
- Pilot scope: 1 production-like pipeline, ~100K monthly requests, 512-token average seq length for context.
- Success criteria: sub-300ms 95th pct latency; cost <= $0.002/token equivalent for production workload; integration with Novadyne KMS for key management.
- Decision window you mentioned: end-of-quarter (internal funding/approval path).

Next steps I propose (quick wins):
1) I attach an updated pricing sheet (Redwood_Pricing_v2.xlsx) and a draft SOW (SOW_draft_v1.pdf) for commercial review.
2) If helpful, we can set a 30-minute commercial sync with procurement + legal to accelerate approvals — I can run the call and bring our contracts SME.
3) Technical kickoff: Priyom can run a focused pilot kickoff to get telemetry flowing in the next 2 weeks if budget/approval are green.

Could you confirm the following when you have a chance:  (a) Is the end-of-quarter timing still the right target? (b) Who else needs to be looped in for procurement/finance sign-off?

If timing slipped, totally fine — let us know and we’ll map an adjusted cadence.

Thanks,
